name: financial-core
objective: Establish one purpose-driven WLT financial core, PaymentAllocation model, account classifications and forward-compatible data/contracts without creating parallel wallet truth.
truthOwner: WLT for wallet/ledger/payment allocation; DSH may persist operational references only.

tasks.objective: Introduce server-owned financial purpose and PaymentAllocation contracts that conserve the governed order total.
tasks.currentProblem: Payment/payment-method fields do not yet provide one explicit accounting purpose/allocation contract for top-up, order payment, COD, earnings and settlement.
tasks.requiredChange: Add canonical purpose/allocation types in WLT contracts/domain and expose them through generated bindings; derive them server-side from trusted order/payment context.
tasks.targetState: Every applicable financial movement has an immutable purpose and every applicable order allocation is conserved and cannot double-count delivery fees.
tasks.action: Extend existing WLT models/contracts first, update DSH references second, regenerate clients, and reject caller-supplied accounting destinations.
mustNotChange: Do not add a second ledger or per-surface balance store.
Do not let provider/payment labels select ledger accounts.
Do not change unrelated order/catalog semantics.
acceptanceCriteria: Allocation components equal the governed order total.
Delivery fee is represented exactly once.
Purpose is server-owned and persisted/readable for audit.
tasks.rollback: Roll forward or revert the focused contract/domain commit before any dependent migration is switched.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused contract/domain commit after generated-client drift is clean.

tasks.objective: Extend ledger account classification and posting policy for asset, liability, income and expense while preserving the single writer.
tasks.currentProblem: The ledger kernel defaults unknown non-wallet account types to liability, which can misclassify payment-processing expense or external settlement cash.
tasks.requiredChange: Introduce an explicit allowlisted account taxonomy/classification and purpose-driven posting policy, including provider clearing, external settlement cash, platform revenue and processing expense.
tasks.targetState: All target postings are balanced, correctly classified and rejected when an unknown account type would silently fall into the wrong class.
tasks.action: Modify the existing ledger kernel/policy and tests; keep PostLedgerTransaction as the sole write path and preserve reference idempotency.
mustNotChange: Do not mutate historical ledger lines.
Do not reinterpret existing account classifications without a migration/backfill proof.
acceptanceCriteria: External settlement cash/clearing classify as assets where policy requires.
Unknown target account types fail closed rather than defaulting silently.
tasks.rollback: Use a forward correcting migration if classification data has been persisted; never rewrite applied migrations.

tasks.objective: Make opening balances, holds/projections and financial corrections auditable ledger-backed facts.
tasks.currentProblem: The target one-wallet model can be undermined if opening balances or corrections are introduced through direct balance updates or if available/held/pending values become parallel balances.
tasks.requiredChange: Represent opening funding and corrections with typed idempotent ledger transactions; derive available/held/pending/earned/settled/withdrawal-eligible projections from canonical state.
tasks.targetState: No financial amount appears without a source transaction/evidence lineage, and projections do not become independent writers.
tasks.action: Search for direct wallet/balance updates, replace value-changing paths with ledger transactions, and add invariant tests for projection consistency.
mustNotChange: Do not edit posted financial history in place.
Do not make visible balance synonymous with withdrawable balance.
acceptanceCriteria: Opening balance has an idempotent source/reference.
One actor/currency resolves to one canonical wallet account.
tasks.rollback: Revert unswitched code or roll forward with compensating migrations; preserve posted history.
